name: FSQ Dev Box Setup
description: Prepare and verify FSQ on an already-connected Windows Dev Box. Deploy the complete package, install the configured source commit, authorize the remote account if needed, and verify native desktop readiness without scoring Cases by default.

variables.name: git-url
variables.description: FSQ source repository prepared on the selected remote Machine.

variables.name: git-branch
variables.description: Remote branch fetched and installed into an exact-commit private venv.

variables.name: bootstrap-python
variables.description: Optional remote Python 3.11+ path; otherwise prepare private Python 3.12.12.

variables.name: edge-exe
variables.description: Optional remote Edge executable path; standard installations are discovered.

variables.name: expected-host
variables.description: Optional Windows hostname guard. Select a remote Machine, not the Hub.

variables.name: authorize-provider
variables.description: If no Provider or GitHub authentication is invalid, start official remote device authorization. Existing other Providers are not replaced.

variables.name: setup-model
variables.description: Model used only when new GitHub Copilot authorization is needed; an existing working Provider/model is preserved.

variables.name: setup-smoke
variables.description: Optionally run one original profile-name Case after environment readiness. Default is environment checks only, including one minimal model connection request.

stages.name: Prepare and verify remote Dev Box
